$comment: ADR-037 register fragment (seed-twilio-sms-source). Seeds the pre-built `twilio-sms` OpenConnector source consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (MessageDispatchProvider) and, transitively, pipelinq's TwilioSmsClient. The Twilio Messaging API authenticates with HTTP Basic (username=AccountSID, password=AuthToken) and the AccountSID also appears in the request path (`/2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSID}/Messages.json`). MOCK MODE (integration-mock-mode): ships with `configuration.mock:true` + a realistic `configuration.mockResponse` (Twilio Messages.json shape, mock SID `MOCK-SMS-TWILIO-0001`, status `queued`) and isEnabled:true, so the dispatch leaf is demonstrably functional end-to-end WITHOUT Twilio Basic credentials — the OpenRegister ExternalIntegrationRouter short-circuits the mock-flagged source and returns the canned success body WITHOUT sending an SMS. To go live: (1) set `configuration.authentication.username` to your AccountSID and `configuration.authentication.password` to your AuthToken (HTTP Basic); (2) the consuming app composes the `Accounts/{AccountSID}/Messages.json` send path so the AccountSID is supplied by the operator, not by end-user input; (3) REMOVE `configuration.mock`. Twilio expects an application/x-www-form-urlencoded body. The base URL is admin-owned on the source (no SSRF surface). OUTBOUND (side-effecting POST) — provider selection / STOP opt-out / dedupe / delivery-status reconciliation stay in the consuming app (pipelinq SmsAdapter).

objects.description: Twilio Messaging API (SMS). Consumed by the OpenRegister outbound-messaging dispatch leaf (POST a single SMS). Dormant placeholder — the base URL is the production Twilio API endpoint; set `configuration.authentication.username` (AccountSID) + `configuration.authentication.password` (AuthToken) for HTTP Basic and enable. Send path is `2010-04-01/Accounts/{AccountSID}/Messages.json` (form-encoded body From/To/Body).
